# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please report it by emailing the repository owner directly rather than opening a public issue.

**DO NOT** open public issues for security vulnerabilities.

## Supported Versions

Only the latest version of this project is currently supported with security updates.

## Security Updates

Security updates are applied as needed. Automated dependency updates are managed through Dependabot on a monthly schedule.

## Access Control

This is a private project. Unauthorized access attempts, pull requests, or issues from unknown contributors will be closed immediately without review.

If you are not an authorized contributor, please do not:
- Open pull requests
- Open issues
- Request repository access
- Fork and submit changes

## Authorized Contributors

Only the repository owner (@Nickog47) is authorized to make changes to this codebase.
